method.cache: warm; no cache clearing; independent inventory warms metadata
method.measured_order: all six permutations twice at default 12 trials; balanced positions and within-trial directed neighbours
method.warmup_order: cyclic rotations, balanced positions at default 3 warmups
method.p95: nearest rank; with 12 trials this is maximum, not a stable tail estimate
method.filesystem_budget: per isolated scan equals selected workers; this experiment is not the service shared budget
method.timing: scan_ms includes root preparation/native observations/traversal/worker joining/reduction; excludes runtime setup, serialization, digest, index and queries
method.rss: OS process high-water at scan return, before diagnostic serialization/hash/index/query work
method.cpu: process user+system CPU time delta across scan, all process threads; null if unsupported
method.correctness: every run checked against independent preflight inventory and matching logical+allocated fingerprint; postflight confirms unchanged fixture; per-node occupancy fingerprints report stability separately because APFS allocation/snapshots can change independently
method.scope: owned synthetic fixtures only; warm-cache single scan; not real-home, cold disk, simultaneous service load, or all devices
